info.name: HashiCorp Vault KV Secrets Engine API

items.docs: Retrieve the current configuration for the KV v2 secrets engine including maximum number of versions, CAS required setting, delete version after duration, and whether the engine is enabled.
Configure backend-level settings for the KV v2 secrets engine including maximum number of secret versions to keep and whether CAS (check-and-set) is required for write operations.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the secret in the KV v2 store. Use forward slashes to organize secrets in a hierarchy. Example: myapp/production/db.

params.name: version
params.description: Specifies the version to return. If not set the latest version is returned.

items.docs: Retrieve the secret data and metadata for a given path from the KV v2 secrets engine. Returns the latest version by default or a specific version if the version parameter is specified.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the secret in the KV v2 store. Use forward slashes to organize secrets in a hierarchy. Example: myapp/production/db.

items.docs: Create or update a secret at the given path in the KV v2 secrets engine. Optionally supports check-and-set (CAS) operation to prevent accidental overwrites. Each write creates a new version.

info.name: HashiCorp Vault Delete Latest Secret Version

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the secret in the KV v2 store. Use forward slashes to organize secrets in a hierarchy. Example: myapp/production/db.

items.docs: Soft delete the latest version of a secret at the given path. The secret data is not permanently removed and can be undeleted. Use the destroy endpoint to permanently remove secret data.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the secret in the KV v2 store. Use forward slashes to organize secrets in a hierarchy. Example: myapp/production/db.

items.docs: Soft delete one or more specified versions of a secret. The deleted versions can be recovered using the undelete endpoint. The key data is not permanently removed.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the secret in the KV v2 store. Use forward slashes to organize secrets in a hierarchy. Example: myapp/production/db.

items.docs: Restore one or more previously soft-deleted versions of a secret. Versions that have been permanently destroyed cannot be recovered.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the secret in the KV v2 store. Use forward slashes to organize secrets in a hierarchy. Example: myapp/production/db.

items.docs: Permanently remove the data for one or more versions of a secret. Unlike soft delete, this operation is irreversible and the data cannot be recovered.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the secret in the KV v2 store. Use forward slashes to organize secrets in a hierarchy. Example: myapp/production/db.

items.docs: Retrieve metadata and version history for a secret at the given path. Returns all version timestamps, current version number, max versions setting, CAS required status, and custom metadata.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the secret in the KV v2 store. Use forward slashes to organize secrets in a hierarchy. Example: myapp/production/db.

items.docs: Create or update metadata for a secret including max versions, CAS required setting, delete version after duration, and custom metadata key-value pairs.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the secret in the KV v2 store. Use forward slashes to organize secrets in a hierarchy. Example: myapp/production/db.

items.docs: Permanently delete all metadata and versions for a secret at the given path. This operation is irreversible and removes all version history.
